data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to hide the keyboard when performing gestures outside of it.
data.what_it_does: KeyboardDismisser is a stateless widget that listens for gestures outside of the active text input and hides the software keyboard automatically. It supports customizable gestures including taps and directional swipes, and can be applied globally by wrapping the MaterialApp or locally to a Scaffold.
use_when: You need a simple way to dismiss the software keyboard when users tap or swipe outside input fields.
You want to apply keyboard dismissal globally to your entire app or to specific pages.
avoid_when: You require complex custom focus management beyond basic gesture dismissal.
strengths: Supports multiple gestures at the same time, including directional swipes.
Can wrap the entire app or individual pages easily.
weaknesses: Not documented for handling advanced custom focus nodes explicitly.
